media.title: Ivan Pavlov's dogs in the U.S.S.R. 1930's. Archive film 97452

timecodes.what: Close-up of a conditioned dog's head with a small saliva collection funnel and tube attached below the cheek as saliva drops form.
Experimenter in a white coat seated at a wall-mounted control panel in the separated observation compartment, operating switches and gauges.
Full side view of the dog standing on a raised wooden stand inside a four-post wooden frame, supported by two leather harness straps hanging from the overhead crossbar.
Close-up of the cheek fistula tube, followed by a white-coated assistant entering to stroke the harnessed dog and place a shallow food bowl under its muzzle.

media.license_note: Archival reference analysed locally in media/M1/ (keyframes + contact_sheet.jpg); never reused in channel videos.

shot_notes: The harness is not a cage: it is an open wooden frame bolted to a tabletop with two leather loops suspended from an overhead wooden bar under the dog's chest and belly.
The dog stands up in the harness with room to shift its weight forward, prick its ears, and lunge toward the front of the stand when food arrives.
The experimenter sits in a separate compartment facing wall-mounted dials, push-buttons, and recording gauges, matching Pavlov's Lecture II description of the soundproof laboratory.

media.title: Pavlovs Dogs (dramatised laboratory recreation)

timecodes.what: Dog in a leather harness on a wooden table eats from a round bowl while a bearded Pavlov figure in a white lab coat watches; macro insert of clear saliva drops sliding down the glass cheek tube.
Wide shot of the bright laboratory with tall multipane windows: dog on the central wooden harness stand, Pavlov on the left, assistant with notebook on the right.
Barrier screen erected; a ticking pyramid metronome starts before food is passed through the hatch.
Close-up of the glass tube cemented to the cheek filling with drops on the metronome tick alone; Pavlov and assistant compare two graduated glass cylinders.

media.license_note: Educational recreation analysed locally in media/M2/ for blocking and prop scale only; never reused in channel videos.

shot_notes: Tall daylight laboratory windows behind the central wooden stand give crisp rim light on the glass cheek funnel and graduated cylinder.
Macro cutaways to the cheek tube clearly show individual clear drops swelling at the spout and raising the meniscus inside the graduated glass tube.
Two-person staging works best in 9:16 vertical framing: dog side-on in the central wooden harness stand, bearded physiologist and white-coated assistant flanking the stand.

media.title: Preserved experimental dog with saliva collection tube, Pavlov Memorial Museum, Ryazan

timecodes.what: Full side photograph of one of Pavlov's preserved dogs (possibly Baikal) showing the small cylindrical glass saliva collector and tube mounted at the cheek.

media.license_note: Museum photograph inspected for prop geometry only; rendered in Flow as a matte-white porcelain dog.

shot_notes: Confirms the compact scale of the cheek-mounted glass collection vial/funnel hanging just below the jaw line.
